ResearchProjectDef.label: city life
ResearchProjectDef.description: Projector screens for a proper cinema, styling chairs for a proper salon, and the know-how to charge admission to a room full of art. Strangers will pay surprising sums for a haircut and a seat in the dark.

ResearchProjectDef.label: taxi and bodyguards
ResearchProjectDef.description: A taxi stand where small shuttles pick guests up and set them down, and a bodyguard service for guests with more money than caution. Needs a working idea of how to land things on purpose.
